name: Orca Status
author: gruut
description: Orca projects and agent status in the Omarchy bar: a traffic-light glance at working, waiting, and blocked agents, with a panel for workspaces.

barWidget.description: Traffic-light status for Orca agents and a panel of projects and workspaces

schema.label: Background refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar updates while the panel is closed. The open panel always refreshes every 2.5 seconds.

schema.label: Orca CLI path
schema.description: Path to the orca binary. Leave empty to auto-detect.

schema.label: Show when idle
schema.description: Keep the bar icon visible even when no agents are active.

schema.label: Keep open
schema.description: Leave the panel open when clicking another window.

schema.label: Notify when blocked
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a workspace becomes blocked.

schema.label: Notify when waiting
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a workspace starts waiting for input.
